title: 雅思·健康与就业精选 · 64 句
description: 围绕本主题练习论点、理由、条件、让步与政策评价；中英对照及逐题讲解，难度 3–5。

items.zh: 弹性工作时间可以减轻通勤压力，但前提是员工对自己的日程有实际控制权。
items.en: Flexible working hours can ease commuting stress, provided that employees have genuine control over their schedules.
answers: Flexible working hours can ease commuting stress, provided that employees have genuine control over their schedules.
items.notes: provided that 表示只要，提出收益实现的条件；control over 是固定搭配。

items.zh: 与等员工精疲力竭后再提供咨询相比，减少长期过重的工作量可能更有效。
items.en: Reducing persistently excessive workloads may be more effective than offering counselling after employees become exhausted.
answers: Reducing persistently excessive workloads may be more effective than offering counselling after employees become exhausted.
items.notes: 平行动名词结构比较预防与补救；persistently 表示持续地。

items.zh: 因为夜班打乱睡眠规律，雇主应留出足够的轮班间隔。
items.en: Because night shifts disrupt sleep patterns, employers should allow sufficient time between shifts.
answers: Because night shifts disrupt sleep patterns, employers should allow sufficient time between shifts.
items.notes: because 引出建议依据；allow time 表示留出时间。

items.zh: 没有带薪病假的员工，即使身体不适，也可能觉得自己必须上班。
items.en: Employees without paid sick leave may feel obliged to work even when they are unwell.
answers: Employees without paid sick leave may feel obliged to work even when they are unwell.
items.notes: feel obliged to 表示觉得有义务或被迫；even when 引出让步情境。

items.zh: 只宣传健康饮食，却不考虑食物价格，可能无法改变低收入家庭的选择。
items.en: Promoting healthy eating without considering food prices may fail to change the choices available to low-income households.
answers: Promoting healthy eating without considering food prices may fail to change the choices available to low-income households.
items.notes: without doing 补充被忽视的因素；available to 修饰 choices。

items.zh: 如果初级医疗更容易获得，一些患者就不必等到症状加重才求医。
items.en: If primary care were more accessible, some patients would not have to wait until their symptoms worsened to seek help.
answers: If primary care were more accessible, some patients would not have to wait until their symptoms worsened to seek help.
items.notes: if + were 搭配 would；until 表示等待终点，seek help 表示求助。

items.zh: 健身设施建得再多，如果居民没有时间使用，也未必能改善健康。
items.en: However many fitness facilities are built, they may do little for health if residents have no time to use them.
answers: However many fitness facilities are built, they may do little for health if residents have no time to use them.
items.notes: however many + 名词引导让步；do little for 表示对某事帮助很小。

items.zh: 企业衡量生产率时，应考虑工作成果，而不只是员工在线的时长。
items.en: When measuring productivity, businesses should consider results rather than merely the hours employees spend online.
answers: When measuring productivity, businesses should consider results rather than merely the hours employees spend online.
items.notes: when doing 的逻辑主语与主句 businesses 一致；rather than 比较评价依据。

items.zh: 接受再培训的工人需要经济支持，才能在学习期间支付日常开销。
items.en: Workers undergoing retraining need financial support to cover living expenses while they study.
answers: Workers undergoing retraining need financial support to cover living expenses while they study.
items.notes: undergoing 是现在分词定语；cover expenses 表示支付开销。

items.zh: 只有当就诊信息保持保密时，部分员工才愿意寻求心理健康帮助。
items.en: Only when consultation records remain confidential are some employees willing to seek mental health support.
answers: Only when consultation records remain confidential are some employees willing to seek mental health support.
items.notes: only when 前置使主句 are 倒装；remain confidential 表示保持保密。

items.zh: 虽然远程办公省去了通勤，却可能让独居员工感到更加孤立。
items.en: Although working remotely removes the commute, it may leave employees who live alone feeling more isolated.
answers: Although working remotely removes the commute, it may leave employees who live alone feeling more isolated.
items.notes: leave + 宾语 + doing 描述所处状态；who 从句限定特定群体。

items.zh: 一项只奖励出勤率的制度，可能无意中鼓励生病的员工继续工作。
items.en: A system that rewards attendance alone may unintentionally encourage employees to work while ill.
answers: A system that rewards attendance alone may unintentionally encourage employees to work while ill.
items.notes: that 从句修饰 system；while ill 是 while they are ill 的省略形式。

items.zh: 真正需要关注的是员工能否恢复精力，而不是休息室里放了多少娱乐设备。
items.en: What deserves attention is whether employees can recover their energy, not how many leisure facilities a break room contains.
answers: What deserves attention is whether employees can recover their energy, not how many leisure facilities a break room contains.
items.notes: what 从句作主语；whether 与 how many 从句构成评价维度的对照。

items.zh: 与其把失业完全归咎于个人，政策制定者不如考察当地是否有合适的岗位。
items.en: Rather than attribute unemployment entirely to individuals, policymakers should examine whether suitable jobs are available locally.
answers: Rather than attribute unemployment entirely to individuals, policymakers should examine whether suitable jobs are available locally.
items.notes: attribute A to B 表示把 A 归因于 B；whether 引导调查的问题。

items.zh: 人口老龄化会增加照护需求，这也会影响仍在工作的家庭成员。
items.en: An ageing population increases demand for care, which also affects family members who are still employed.
answers: An ageing population increases demand for care, which also affects family members who are still employed.
items.notes: which 指代前面照护需求增加这件事；who 从句修饰 family members。

items.zh: 职业安全培训应定期更新，以反映设备和工作流程的变化。
items.en: Occupational safety training should be updated regularly to reflect changes in equipment and working procedures.
answers: Occupational safety training should be updated regularly to reflect changes in equipment and working procedures.
items.notes: 被动语态聚焦培训；to reflect 表示更新的目的。

items.zh: 即使最低工资提高，住房成本的增长也可能抵消员工的收入增幅。
items.en: Even if the minimum wage rises, higher housing costs may offset workers' income gains.
answers: Even if the minimum wage rises, higher housing costs may offset workers' income gains.
items.notes: even if 承认政策变化；offset gains 表示抵消收益。

items.zh: 员工越担心失去工作，就越可能不愿报告安全问题。
items.en: The more employees fear losing their jobs, the less willing they may be to report safety concerns.
answers: The more employees fear losing their jobs, the less willing they may be to report safety concerns.
items.notes: the more ... the less ... 表示反向变化；fear 后可接动名词。

items.zh: 为了让照护者重返职场，培训课程可以提供非全日制学习安排。
items.en: To help carers return to work, training courses could offer part-time study options.
answers: To help carers return to work, training courses could offer part-time study options.
items.notes: to do 引出目的；carer 在英式英语中指照护者，不是职业 career。

items.zh: 短期合同虽然为企业提供了灵活性，却可能让员工难以规划未来。
items.en: Short-term contracts offer businesses flexibility while making it harder for workers to plan ahead.
answers: Short-term contracts offer businesses flexibility while making it harder for workers to plan ahead.
items.notes: while doing 表示同时产生的另一面影响；make it harder for sb to do 中 it 为形式宾语。

items.zh: 如果当时有更清楚的安全规程，这起工作场所事故或许可以避免。
items.en: The workplace accident might have been prevented if clearer safety procedures had been in place.
answers: The workplace accident might have been prevented if clearer safety procedures had been in place.
items.notes: might have been prevented 为过去虚拟被动；be in place 表示已建立并可使用。

items.zh: 公共卫生宣传不仅需要准确的信息，也需要公众能够信任的传播者。
items.en: Public health campaigns need not only accurate information but also messengers whom the public can trust.
answers: Public health campaigns need not only accurate information but also messengers whom the public can trust.
items.notes: not only ... but also ... 并列宾语；whom 为 trust 的宾语。

items.zh: 当医疗预约只能通过手机完成时，不熟悉智能设备的人可能会错过治疗。
items.en: When medical appointments can only be booked through a mobile app, people unfamiliar with smart devices may miss out on treatment.
answers: When medical appointments can only be booked through a mobile app, people unfamiliar with smart devices may miss out on treatment.
items.notes: unfamiliar with 修饰 people；miss out on 表示错失。

items.zh: 无论一份工作薪水多高，员工都应享有基本的休息时间。
items.en: No matter how well a job pays, employees should be entitled to basic rest periods.
answers: No matter how well a job pays, employees should be entitled to basic rest periods.
items.notes: no matter how 引导让步从句；be entitled to 表示有权获得。

items.zh: 预防性筛查的价值，需要与误报和后续检查的负担一并考虑。
items.en: The value of preventive screening needs to be weighed against false alarms and the burden of follow-up tests.
answers: The value of preventive screening needs to be weighed against false alarms and the burden of follow-up tests.
items.notes: weigh A against B：权衡利弊。

items.zh: 人们知道健康建议，并不意味着他们有条件照着做。
items.en: Knowing health advice does not mean people have the means to follow it.
answers: Knowing health advice does not mean people have the means to follow it.
Knowing health advice doesn't mean people have the means to follow it.
items.notes: have the means to do：具备实现条件。

items.zh: 在缺少新鲜食品供应的地区，单靠个人意愿很难改善饮食。
items.en: Personal motivation alone may do little to improve diets where fresh food is hard to obtain.
answers: Personal motivation alone may do little to improve diets where fresh food is hard to obtain.
items.notes: where 引出某种生活环境。

items.zh: 清晰的食品标签有助于比较产品，但前提是标注单位保持一致。
items.en: Clear food labels can help consumers compare products if the units used are consistent.
answers: Clear food labels can help consumers compare products if the units used are consistent.
items.notes: used 为修饰 units 的分词。

items.zh: 针对儿童的食品营销可能影响家庭采购，而不仅影响儿童自己的选择。
items.en: Food marketing aimed at children may influence household purchases as well as children's own choices.
answers: Food marketing aimed at children may influence household purchases as well as children's own choices.
items.notes: aimed at：面向某群体的。

items.zh: 戒烟支持需要考虑成瘾的困难，而不能只依靠责备。
items.en: Smoking cessation support needs to recognise the difficulty of addiction rather than rely on blame alone.
answers: Smoking cessation support needs to recognise the difficulty of addiction rather than rely on blame alone.
items.notes: rather than 比较支持方式。

items.zh: 运动处方应适应个人能力，而不是给所有人同一套强度要求。
items.en: Exercise prescriptions should reflect individual abilities instead of imposing identical intensity requirements on everyone.
answers: Exercise prescriptions should reflect individual abilities instead of imposing identical intensity requirements on everyone.
items.notes: impose requirements on：向人施加要求。

items.zh: 慢性病管理常常需要连续照护，单次就诊只能解决部分问题。
items.en: Chronic disease management often requires continuity of care, so a single appointment can address only part of the problem.
answers: Chronic disease management often requires continuity of care, so a single appointment can address only part of the problem.
items.notes: continuity of care：照护连续性。

items.zh: 患者在不同机构间转诊时，记录传递不完整可能造成重复检查。
items.en: Incomplete transfer of records between providers may lead to repeated tests when patients are referred.
answers: Incomplete transfer of records between providers may lead to repeated tests when patients are referred.
items.notes: refer a patient：转诊患者。

items.zh: 等待时间应按病情紧急程度解读，而不是简单比较平均数字。
items.en: Waiting times should be interpreted in relation to clinical urgency rather than compared only as averages.
answers: Waiting times should be interpreted in relation to clinical urgency rather than compared only as averages.
items.notes: in relation to：结合某因素。

items.zh: 远程问诊能节省路程，却不适合所有需要身体检查的情况。
items.en: Remote consultations save travel but are not suitable for every condition requiring a physical examination.
answers: Remote consultations save travel but are not suitable for every condition requiring a physical examination.
Remote consultations save travel but aren't suitable for every condition requiring a physical examination.
items.notes: requiring 为修饰 condition 的分词。

items.zh: 医生使用患者听得懂的语言，可以减少离院后的误解。
items.en: Using language patients understand can help clinicians reduce misunderstandings after discharge.
answers: Using language patients understand can help clinicians reduce misunderstandings after discharge.
items.notes: discharge 在此指离院、出院。

items.zh: 翻译服务对医疗安全的作用，不应只以使用人数衡量。
items.en: The contribution of interpreting services to patient safety should not be measured solely by usage figures.
answers: The contribution of interpreting services to patient safety should not be measured solely by usage figures.
items.notes: contribution to：对某方面的贡献。

items.zh: 照护者也可能需要休息支持，否则长期照护难以持续。
items.en: Carers may need respite support themselves if long-term care is to remain sustainable.
answers: Carers may need respite support themselves if long-term care is to remain sustainable.
items.notes: respite：暂时减轻照护负担的休息。

items.zh: 随着治疗选择增多，患者更需要理解收益与副作用之间的取舍。
items.en: As treatment options expand, patients need a clearer understanding of trade-offs between benefits and side effects.
answers: As treatment options expand, patients need a clearer understanding of trade-offs between benefits and side effects.
items.notes: trade-offs between：两者之间的取舍。

items.zh: 心理健康服务若只在工作时间开放，可能难以服务无法请假的人。
items.en: Mental health services offered only during working hours may fail to reach people unable to take leave.
answers: Mental health services offered only during working hours may fail to reach people unable to take leave.
items.notes: offered 与 unable 均作后置修饰。

items.zh: 污名可能让人隐瞒症状，即使服务本身已经免费。
items.en: Stigma may lead people to conceal symptoms even when services are free.
answers: Stigma may lead people to conceal symptoms even when services are free.
items.notes: even when 承认已有有利条件。

items.zh: 预防传染病需要可信的信息，也需要居民能够执行的实际安排。
items.en: Preventing infectious disease requires credible information and practical arrangements people can follow.
answers: Preventing infectious disease requires credible information and practical arrangements people can follow.
items.notes: 省略关系代词的从句修饰 arrangements。

items.zh: 医护人员短缺会影响服务质量，而不只是延长预约等待。
items.en: Staff shortages in healthcare can affect quality as well as extend appointment waits.
answers: Staff shortages in healthcare can affect quality as well as extend appointment waits.
items.notes: as well as 连接两种影响。

items.zh: 偏远地区留住医护人员，可能需要住房、培训和职业发展方面的共同支持。
items.en: Retaining healthcare staff in remote areas may require combined support for housing, training and career development.
answers: Retaining healthcare staff in remote areas may require combined support for housing, training and career development.
items.notes: retain：留住，而非仅招聘。

items.zh: 生产率提高后，收益是否转化为更短工时，取决于企业如何分配收益。
items.en: Whether productivity gains lead to shorter hours depends on how businesses distribute the benefits.
answers: Whether productivity gains lead to shorter hours depends on how businesses distribute the benefits.
items.notes: whether 从句作主语，how 从句作宾语。

items.zh: 四天工作制若只是把相同工作量挤进更少天数，就未必减轻压力。
items.en: A four-day week may not ease stress if it merely compresses the same workload into fewer days.
answers: A four-day week may not ease stress if it merely compresses the same workload into fewer days.
items.notes: compress A into B：将工作压缩到某范围。

items.zh: 员工有权下班后不回复消息，可以帮助形成更清楚的休息边界。
items.en: A right to disconnect after work can help establish clearer boundaries around rest.
answers: A right to disconnect after work can help establish clearer boundaries around rest.
items.notes: right to disconnect：非工作时间断联权。

items.zh: 自由职业提供自主性，也可能让收入和保障更不稳定。
items.en: Freelancing offers autonomy but may bring less predictable income and protection.
answers: Freelancing offers autonomy but may bring less predictable income and protection.
items.notes: predictable：可预期的。

items.zh: 零工平台的评分如果缺乏申诉渠道，工人可能难以纠正不公平的评价。
items.en: Gig workers may struggle to correct unfair ratings when platforms provide no route of appeal.
answers: Gig workers may struggle to correct unfair ratings when platforms provide no route of appeal.
items.notes: a route of appeal：申诉渠道。

items.zh: 绩效奖金若只奖励个人结果，可能削弱团队分享经验的意愿。
items.en: Bonuses tied only to individual results may weaken a team's willingness to share knowledge.
answers: Bonuses tied only to individual results may weaken a team's willingness to share knowledge.
items.notes: tied to：与某因素挂钩。

items.zh: 升职标准透明，能够帮助员工判断自己需要发展哪些能力。
items.en: Transparent promotion criteria help employees identify which abilities they need to develop.
answers: Transparent promotion criteria help employees identify which abilities they need to develop.
items.notes: which 从句明确识别内容。

items.zh: 非正式的人脉招聘，可能让没有行业联系的人更难进入职场。
items.en: Informal recruitment through personal networks can disadvantage people without industry connections.
answers: Informal recruitment through personal networks can disadvantage people without industry connections.
items.notes: through 表示招聘途径。

items.zh: 求职空白期不应自动被解释为缺乏能力或动力。
items.en: A gap in employment should not automatically be taken as evidence of limited ability or motivation.
answers: A gap in employment should not automatically be taken as evidence of limited ability or motivation.
items.notes: take A as evidence of B：把 A 当作 B 的证据。

items.zh: 父母双方都能获得育儿假，可能有助于更公平地分担照护工作。
items.en: Parental leave available to both parents may support a fairer division of care.
answers: Parental leave available to both parents may support a fairer division of care.
items.notes: a division of care：照护责任分配。

items.zh: 培训安排在下班之后，可能排除需要接送孩子的员工。
items.en: Training scheduled after work may exclude employees who need to collect their children.
answers: Training scheduled after work may exclude employees who need to collect their children.
items.notes: scheduled 作分词定语。

items.zh: 组织重组期间，清楚说明哪些决定尚未确定，可以减少不必要的猜测。
items.en: During restructuring, clarity about which decisions remain open can reduce unnecessary speculation.
answers: During restructuring, clarity about which decisions remain open can reduce unnecessary speculation.
items.notes: remain open：尚未决定。

items.zh: 员工调查只有带来后续行动，才更可能维持参与者的信任。
items.en: Staff surveys are more likely to retain participants' trust when they lead to follow-up action.
answers: Staff surveys are more likely to retain participants' trust when they lead to follow-up action.
items.notes: lead to 后接名词。

items.zh: 管理者承认不知道某些答案，可以让团队更愿意报告问题。
items.en: Managers who acknowledge uncertainty may encourage their teams to report problems more openly.
answers: Managers who acknowledge uncertainty may encourage their teams to report problems more openly.
items.notes: acknowledge：承认，正视。

items.zh: 面对顾客的辱骂，服务人员需要明确的组织支持，而不只是被要求保持微笑。
items.en: Staff facing abusive customers need clear organisational support, not simply instructions to keep smiling.
answers: Staff facing abusive customers need clear organisational support, not simply instructions to keep smiling.
items.notes: facing 为修饰 staff 的分词。

items.zh: 高温下的户外劳动需要调整作息，因为个人耐受能力无法替代安全安排。
items.en: Outdoor work in extreme heat requires schedule adjustments, since individual endurance cannot replace safety measures.
answers: Outdoor work in extreme heat requires schedule adjustments, since individual endurance cannot replace safety measures.
Outdoor work in extreme heat requires schedule adjustments, since individual endurance can't replace safety measures.
items.notes: endurance：耐受力、耐力。

items.zh: 新设备投入使用时，临时工也应获得与正式员工相同的安全培训。
items.en: Temporary workers should receive the same safety training as permanent staff when new equipment is introduced.
answers: Temporary workers should receive the same safety training as permanent staff when new equipment is introduced.
items.notes: the same ... as ... 表示同等要求。

items.zh: 退休年龄调整应考虑职业之间体力要求的差异。
items.en: Changes to retirement age should account for differences in physical demands across occupations.
answers: Changes to retirement age should account for differences in physical demands across occupations.
items.notes: account for：考虑到。

items.zh: 年长员工传授经验的机会，可能同时帮助新员工适应工作。
items.en: Opportunities for older employees to pass on experience may also help new recruits settle into their roles.
answers: Opportunities for older employees to pass on experience may also help new recruits settle into their roles.
items.notes: pass on：传授；settle into：逐渐适应。

items.zh: 衡量工作的价值时，社会贡献也值得考虑，而不仅是市场工资。
items.en: Social contribution deserves consideration when the value of work is assessed, not just market pay.
answers: Social contribution deserves consideration when the value of work is assessed, not just market pay.
items.notes: deserve consideration：值得考虑。
